mission: Ward — validação e auditoria de contratos de API e regras de BOLA/IDOR em staging
method: static analysis of local artifacts only; no live requests, no discovery, no credential access
evidence_note: Every hash, line reference, test result and probe outcome below is reproducible from the local filesystem with the commands recorded in deterministic_checks. generated_at_utc is the only non-deterministic field.

supporting.note: test harness for the validator; executed offline

route_integrity_probe.method: importlib load of bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py; call target() with hostile and valid inputs

evidence: bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:20-21 — HOST and TEMPLATE are fixed constants; no caller-supplied host or path

bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:37-40 — scheme must be https, hostname must equal HOST, port must be None or 443, userinfo/query/fragment forbidden, path must equal TEMPLATE exactly, netloc must equal HOST exactly (case-sensitive, rejects uppercase host)
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:41 — resource_id must fullmatch [0-9]{1,32}
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:45 — substitution uses quote(resource_id, safe=''); digits-only input makes encoding a no-op
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:29-31 — NoRedirect refuses all redirects
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:74 — ProxyHandler({}) disables proxy pickup
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:75 — GET only
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:20-21 — single fixed host and single fixed path; no tenant segment, no tenant header
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:75 — request carries only Cookie and Accept; no tenant identifier
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:86-103 — contrast() distinguishes only control vs test session; it cannot distinguish tenant A from tenant B
tenant_isolation.impact: Cross-tenant IDOR is indistinguishable from cross-user IDOR in this contract. A tenant-confusion case cannot be expressed or detected.

evidence: bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:90 — proof_of_bola hardcoded False; the tool never claims proof
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:91-93 — control must be 200 or the run stops (CONTROL_NOT_200_STOP)
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:94 — 1s serial interval, no retry
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:97-98 — 403/404 -> EXPECTED_DENIAL
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:99-100 — 200 -> BOLA_CANDIDATE with code CONTENT_AND_IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED (content review deferred to human)
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:102 — any other status -> UNEXPECTED_STATUS_STOP
bola_idor_rules.gap: Verdict is status-only. A 200 with a generic empty shell is reported as BOLA_CANDIDATE; docs/H1-MELI-SPEC-V10.md:50 states 'HTTP 200 com casca genérica não é achado'. The content-aware discrimination exists only in bin/mitr3-onda10-exec.py:249-251 (NEGATIVE_SHELL).

evidence: bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:73-83 — fetch() returns status only; body is never read, logged, parsed or followed
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:29-31,74-75 — no redirects, no proxy, GET only
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:49 — O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK; symlink refused
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:51-54 — regular file, owner uid, exact 0600 mode
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:55-57 — 65536-byte cap enforced by reading 65537 bytes
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:58-70 — origin pinned to https://www.mercadolivre.com.br; cookie name/value charset restricted
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:123 — distinct sessions required (a != b)
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:117 — dry-run is the default; prints mode only
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:120-121 — live execution requires --execute AND --authorized-test-users
bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:128 — errors return verdict INCONCLUSIVE with a code, never a partial success

defects.title: RESOURCE_ID_INVALID error code is dead
defects.evidence: bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:25 declares ValidationError(ValueError); line 42 raises ValidationError('RESOURCE_ID_INVALID'); lines 43-44 catch ValueError and re-raise ValidationError('READ_ONLY_ENDPOINT_REQUIRED'). The specific code can never surface.

staging_contract.tenant_isolation_note: No tenant dimension exists in the order API contract. Tenant isolation, if present, is server-side and unverifiable offline.

findings.title: Named audit target bin/mitr3-web-api.py does not exist
findings.evidence: find / -xdev -name 'mitr3-web-api.py' -> 0 hits; no git history in /home/nielz/MITR3/MITR3; absent from staging repo and both worktrees
findings.impact: The API-contract validation artifact named in the mission cannot be reviewed. The audit of API-contract tooling is incomplete by construction.
findings.remediation: Provide the artifact or confirm the intended path. If it is meant to be built, scope it separately; do not substitute a different file silently.

findings.title: Tenant isolation is not modeled in the validator or the staging contract
findings.impact: Cross-tenant IDOR cannot be distinguished from cross-user IDOR offline. A tenant-confusion case passes all structural gates.
findings.remediation: Add a tenant binding (header or path segment) and a tenant-confusion case (T1/T2) to both the validator contract and the staging matrix.

findings.title: Validator route family does not cover the staging order API
findings.evidence: bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:20-21 (/addresses/extra-info-details/{resource_id} on www.mercadolivre.com.br) vs templates line 1 (/orders/$ORDER_ID[/shipments|/billing_info] on api.mercadolivre.com)
findings.impact: The BOLA/IDOR rules for the Onda 10 order route live in bin/mitr3-onda10-exec.py, not in the validator. The validator alone is insufficient to audit the staging order contract.
findings.remediation: Reconcile: either extend the validator to the order route family or document that onda10-exec.py is the order-route rule engine and the validator is address-route only.

findings.title: RESOURCE_ID_INVALID error code is masked by the ValueError handler
findings.impact: Auditability only; rejection behaviour is correct.
findings.remediation: Raise a non-ValueError sentinel for endpoint errors, or reorder the checks so RESOURCE_ID_INVALID is raised outside the try.

findings.title: Validator BOLA verdict is status-only and cannot discriminate a generic 200 shell
findings.evidence: bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:99-100; docs/H1-MELI-SPEC-V10.md:50; content-aware alternative at bin/mitr3-onda10-exec.py:249-251
findings.impact: Over-reporting of BOLA_CANDIDATE; human content review required on every 200.
findings.remediation: Add a content-shape check (empty/metadata shell -> NEGATIVE_SHELL) mirroring onda10-exec.py.

findings.title: Route parameter integrity is strong in the validator
findings.evidence: bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:37-45; route_integrity_probe: 6/6 hostile endpoints and 5/5 hostile resource_ids rejected
findings.impact: Positive finding; path manipulation, host confusion, query/fragment injection and non-numeric ids are all refused.

findings.title: Staging template structural integrity is strong
findings.evidence: staging_gate.py:41-92,124-132; deterministic_checks.staging_gate: PASS_STRUCTURAL_ONLY, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 network calls
findings.impact: Positive finding; framing, placeholder, host and identity-allowlist gates hold.

findings.title: proof_of_bola is hardcoded False
findings.impact: Positive finding; the tool never asserts proof, only candidacy.

findings.title: Validator has no request budget or rate-limit handling beyond a 1s sleep
findings.evidence: bin/mitr3-h1-validator.py:94; contrast is capped at 2 requests by design
findings.impact: Low risk at current scope (2 requests); a broader run could exceed 60/host/h.
findings.remediation: Add an explicit budget/rate guard if the validator is extended beyond 2 requests.

blocking_conditions: F-001: bin/mitr3-web-api.py is absent; the mission's primary audit target cannot be reviewed.
